definitions.explanation: Describes an institution (school, hospital, museum, park, etc.) that is established and operated by a prefectural government. Used as a prefix to the institution name.

examples.japanese: {県立|けんりつ}{高校|こうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: To attend a prefectural high school.

examples.japanese: {県立|けんりつ}⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: An exhibition is being held at the prefectural art museum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{県立|けんりつ}⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: My son was born at a prefectural hospital.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (prefecture) + {立|りつ} (established). Functions as a prefix to institution names, indicating that the institution is funded and operated by a prefectural government.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {県立|けんりつ}{高校|こうこう}: prefectural high school
- {県立|けんりつ}⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧: prefectural hospital
- {県立|けんりつ}⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧: prefectural art museum
- {県立|けんりつ}⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧: prefectural library
- {県立|けんりつ}⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧: prefectural park

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{国立|こくりつ}→国立：04153_kokuritsu⟧: national (government-run)
- ⟦{市立|しりつ}→市立：19923_shiritsu⟧: municipal (city-run)
- ⟦{都立|とりつ}→都立：27990_toritsu⟧: metropolitan (Tokyo-run)
- {府立|ふりつ}: prefectural (Osaka/Kyoto — for ⟦{府|ふ}→府：09870_fu⟧ rather than ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧)
- ⟦{私立|しりつ}→私立：00370_shiritsu⟧: private (privately run)
- ⟦{公立|こうりつ}→公立：08210_kouritsu⟧: public (any level of government)
